crossRefs.note: The matter is not so. But a man of the hill country of Ephraim, Sheba the son of Bichri by name, has lifted up his hand…
“If you have done foolishly in lifting up yourself, or if you have thought evil, put your hand over your mouth.
Yahweh, your hand is lifted up, yet they don’t see; but they will see your zeal for the people, and be disappointed.…
This is the reason of the levy which king Solomon raised, to build Yahweh’s house, his own house, Millo, Jerusalem’s…
But Pharaoh’s daughter came up out of David’s city to her house which Solomon had built for her. Then he built Millo.
In that day I will raise up the tent of David who is fallen, and close up its breaches, and I will raise up its ruins…
But when Sanballat, Tobiah, the Arabians, the Ammonites, and the Ashdodites heard that the repairing of the walls of…
You have made the land tremble. You have torn it. Mend its fractures, for it quakes.
You saw the breaches of David’s city, that they were many; and you gathered together the waters of the lower pool.
You have not gone up into the gaps or built up the wall for the house of Israel, to stand in the battle in Yahweh’s day.
Nevertheless David took the stronghold of Zion. This is David’s city.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

people.name: Millo
people.line: A fortification in Jerusalem built by Solomon

people.name: Solomon
people.line: Son of David, king of Israel, known for his wisdom.

translations.web: This was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of his father David’s city.
translations.bsb: and this is the account of his rebellion against the king. Solomon had built the supporting terraces and repaired the gap in the wall of the city of his father David.
translations.kjv: And this was the cause that he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breaches of the city of David his father.
translations.asv: And this was the reason why he lifted up his hand against the king: Solomon built Millo, and repaired the breach of the city of David his father.
